newsitem.title: CHINA: China gets $80 million loan for Kuwait crude deal.
newsitem.headline: China gets $80 million loan for Kuwait crude deal.

text.p: The China National Petroleum Engineering and Construction Co. has obtained an $80 million loan to help finance a project to construct crude oil gathering centres in Kuwait, the Market Daily newspaper said on Friday.

The loan from a consortium of banks from Japan, Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium represented the first effort by a Chinese company to obtain overseas financing for this type of project, the newspaper added.

The Kuwait project, worth a total of $398 million, is the largest overseas construction project that China has obtained through international bidding, it said. China National Petroleum Engineering and Construction is a subsidiary of the China National Petroleum Corp.
